scope: Conditional R2 plan fixed before opening R1 test results; execute only after the R1 continuation gate
training_source: Existing 152 accepted training structure pairs, 31 superfamilies, no new validation/test labels in training
sampling: Nested deterministic round robin over superfamilies, one pair per available group before second pair; all valid residue pairs in each selected structure pair, both directions
sampling_batches: Fixed-seed random batches with replacement; equal optimizer steps across data fractions
model: Unchanged paired 10-10-10-2 encoder, 20x2 codebook and Gaussian decoder; commitment 0.25
checkpoint_rule: Minimum original paired-feature validation total loss at steps 100..4200
primary_model_rule: Among full-data runs, minimum paired validation loss, tie seed ascending
alternative_rule_analysis: Compare the above rule to validation search MAP selection only on validation; do not substitute test-based selection
matrix: Same estimator as R1, using only the selected training structure-pair subset; learning-curve effect includes matrix estimation data
test_search: Frozen R1 test set for the prespecified 15-run ablation; disclose prior baseline evaluation and do not call it a new independent dataset
test_reporting: All 15 runs plus per-fraction seed mean and standard deviation; sign consistency of full-minus-quarter paired seed deltas
noise_policy: Independent Gaussian displacement on observed atom coordinates, fixed per-structure seed; a numerical stress test, not a physical uncertainty model
stability_models: Official encoder and the primary selected full-data learned encoder

soft_seed_validation.mechanism: Query-only alternative second-nearest center at at most one position per 3mer; preserve masks and deduplicate positional hits
soft_seed_validation.selection: Require retain_exact_at_10 >=0.98 on validation, then minimize candidate count; ties use smaller threshold
soft_seed_validation.failure: If none meets the gate, record failure and do not tune on test

novelty: No novelty claim; controlled small-data ablation and numerical-stability experiment
